start.speaker: yev
start.text: My people would call this heresy: choosing one root when the whole grove is offered. I have thought about it under three moons. I choose the root. If you will be chosen.

choices.text: I cannot be one root, Yev. I am sorry.

chosen.speaker: yev
chosen.text: Then it is done, and the Weft can say what it likes. Sleep. I will keep the current off you.

no.speaker: yev
no.text: Then be the stream. Nothing is wasted in a grove.
